parts.text: Can you tell me about product PRD-001? What are its features and warranty?
SmartHub Pro supports up to 200 smart devices via Zigbee, Z-Wave, and Wi-Fi. It comes with a 2-year warranty and runs firmware version 3.2.1.
My device went offline after a firmware update. The error code is E1001. How do I fix this?
Power-cycle the device by unplugging it for 30 seconds. If still offline, factory-reset by holding the reset button for 10 seconds.
